newsitem.title: USA: CME hog futures end mixed, pork bellies tumble.
newsitem.headline: CME hog futures end mixed, pork bellies tumble.

text.p: CME hog futures traded in a narrow range and closed mixed but pork bellies tumbled late as commercial pressure turned futures technically weak and sell stops were hit near the close, traders said.
Live hogs closed 0.175 cent per lb lower to 0.250 higher with February off 0.125 at 77.600 cents. Pork bellies fell to close 1.250 to 2.375 cents lower with February down 1.525 at 76.050.

Hog futures traded on both sides of previous levels following mixed market factors. Technical support after Tuesday's reversal was offset by the premium of futures to cash and effects of bitterly cold weather, traders said.

Hazardous wind chill factors the next couple of days will restrict hog marketings, but those hogs will eventually come to market when temperatures moderate, a fact that kept a lid on the market, they said.
R.J. O'Brien bought on the early recovery after selling by Rosenthal Collins and Cargill Investor Services, pit sources said.
In hog options, volatility was down in February and April in light trade. ING sold February 80 puts early and R.J. O'Brien sold that put late, pit sources added.
